summary: Completed comprehensive testing of new Open API CRM integration features: Field Discovery Service, Integration Profiles, and Connection Wizard UI. All 42 backend tests passed (23 new + 19 existing). Frontend Connection Wizard tested through all 4 steps successfully.
test_credentials: None required - all tests use mock_mode=true and sample JSON for field discovery
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Complete Wizard integration during testing (deleted after tests)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new Open API CRM integration features fully tested and working. Field Discovery Service auto-maps fields with high confidence (email_address->email, phone_number->phone, etc.). Integration Profiles include 4 built-in profiles (VinSolutions, DealerSocket, elead, Generic REST). Connection Wizard provides 4-step setup flow with Auto-Fetch/Paste Sample toggle for field discovery.

details: GET /api/integrations/schema/customers - Returns customer schema with priority fields (name, phone required)
GET /api/integrations/schema/vehicles - Returns vehicle schema with priority fields (year, make, model required)
POST /api/integrations/discover-fields/sample - Discovers fields from pasted JSON sample
Auto-mapping works: email_address->email, phone_number->phone with high confidence
Nested JSON field discovery works
Array sample extraction works (takes first record)
Invalid JSON returns proper error
Unmapped required fields are flagged with warnings
GET /api/integration-profiles - Lists profiles including 4 built-in ones
POST /api/integration-profiles - Creates new profile
GET /api/integration-profiles/{id} - Gets profile by ID
GET /api/integration-profiles/{id}/export - Exports profile as JSON (excludes sensitive fields)
POST /api/integration-profiles/import - Imports profile from JSON
Import with name override works
Invalid JSON import returns 400
Missing required fields import returns 400
PATCH /api/integration-profiles/{id} - Updates profile
Cannot modify built-in profiles (returns 400)
Cannot delete built-in profiles (returns 400)
Profile filtering by adapter_type works
Profile filtering by tags works

backend_crm_integrations.details: All existing CRM integration tests pass (adapters, CRUD, health, webhooks)
